kokoro.name: kokoro
kokoro.notes: StyleTTS2 + ISTFTNet, 82M, 54 voices, 40 Hz frame rate. The teacher Paradee distilled (af_heart, 12k WikiText-103 sentences -> 23.9 h). Needs espeak-ng/misaki for G2P.

speechify.name: speechify
speechify.weights_license: proprietary hosted service.  Used under permission the operator obtained in writing from the provider, stated to cover demonstration/quantization purposes for this task
speechify.notes: Speechify speech API (`simba-3.2`), 48 kHz WAV, and -- uniquely among the teachers wired up here -- it returns **speech marks**: per-word character offsets with millisecond timings.  That is the alignment this project has otherwise never had: every duration target so far came from the unaligned fallback, which rounds 19 and 22 measured to be a real quality limit.  LICENCE DISTINCTION, recorded rather than smoothed over: the operator's written permission is stated for *demonstration/quantization*; publishing derivative weights trained on this audio is a broader use than that wording establishes, so the model card lists it explicitly and docs/LEGAL.md should be revisited before any release.  Measured DNSMOS on one sample: 3.19 (P.835 overall) against Kokoro's 2.86 corpus mean.
